effective_PDF.finding: density dispatch uses global PDLABEL, not the stored PDSUBLABEL proton labels

running_order.finding: pdfwrap defaults to2 loops; CTEQ6L1 overrides to1, nn23lo1 does not; native retained-ALPS audit confirms the actual difference

primary_unweight.finding: overweight excess is retained using max(abs(weight),target); printed second field is100*xover/xtot. Raw first field is internal weight, not a percent or a pb loss

native_error.finding: relative-variance weighted last<=3 iterations; error inflated by sqrt(chi2) only if chi2>1. One-iteration chi2=0 is not empirical convergence or zero MC error

secondary_unweight.finding: upstream integral recorded before final event-target thinning; realized final truncation and inclusion-history cannot be reconstructed because candidate files were cleaned

metadata_PDF_ID.finding: header/card metadata contradict the actual C density execution; header alone is insufficient source identity evidence
